selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What is the title of the passage?
questions.answer: The Supreme Sign.

questions.question: What does the opening line in Arabic and English tell us before the passage begins?
questions.answer: It begins in the name of Allah, showing that the discussion starts by remembering Him.

questions.question: What does the verse say people do not understand well?
questions.answer: People do not understand how the created things glorify Allah.

questions.question: Why does the passage begin with the heavens?
questions.answer: Because the heavens are always seen by people and they clearly point to Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What two big questions does the traveler ask when he enters the world?
questions.answer: He asks who made this world and who rules it.

questions.question: What amazing thing does the traveler notice about the heavenly bodies?
questions.answer: He sees huge bodies held up with no pillars or supports.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the lights in the sky?
questions.answer: They keep shining without needing fuel like oil.

questions.question: How are the strong powers in the heavenly bodies described?
questions.answer: They are made obedient to a law.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the movement of heavenly bodies?
questions.answer: They are compared to a disciplined army doing maneuvers.

questions.question: What main idea about the heavens is the traveler meant to understand?
questions.answer: The heavens are carefully controlled and ordered, and this points to Allah’s power and rule.

questions.question: What is the main subject of the passage?
questions.answer: It is about a traveler learning about Allah by observing the universe.

questions.question: What important limit does the verse place on human understanding?
questions.answer: Humans do not fully grasp the way creation praises Allah.

questions.question: What does the traveler think the world is like?
questions.answer: He sees it as a welcoming, well-prepared, meaningful place.

questions.question: What appears before the traveler first?
questions.answer: The beautiful sky filled with stars.

questions.question: What does the traveler see happening in the heavens?
questions.answer: He sees a ruling power carrying out many tasks.

questions.question: Why is their movement also surprising?
questions.answer: Because they move very fast and still do not hit each other.

questions.question: What does the phrase about managing everything “at the same time” show?
questions.answer: It shows great power, perfect control, and no weakness in ruling creation.

questions.question: Why are the heavenly bodies compared to an army?
questions.answer: Because they move in a controlled, organized, and obedient way.

questions.question: What feeling is the passage trying to build in the reader through these examples?
questions.answer: Wonder at the order and greatness of Allah’s creation.

questions.question: How does this passage encourage faith?
questions.answer: It tells us to observe creation carefully and see Allah’s signs in it.

questions.question: In simple words, what is “The Supreme Sign” about?
questions.answer: It is about finding proof of Allah by looking at the universe.

questions.question: What does the Qur’anic verse say about the seven heavens and the earth?
questions.answer: It says they glorify Allah.

questions.question: What are people unable to fully understand in that verse?
questions.answer: The way creation praises Allah.

questions.question: How is the world described as a place for people?
questions.answer: As a place of kindness, wisdom, beauty, and learning.
